auth.password_rules: At least 8 characters, not a common password.
auth.signup_link: No account yet? Register your shop
auth.have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.owner_pin_help: 4–6 digits, to sign in on the cashier app. No repeated digits (1111), runs (1234, 4321) or common patterns (1212).

menu.empty_categories: Start with categories such as Coffee, Non-coffee or Food, then add items to them.
menu.empty_items: No items in this category yet.
menu.confirm_archive_item: Archive item "{name}"? Sales history is kept.
menu.empty_items_help: Enter a name and price. After saving, open the item to set its recipe and modifier groups.

item.no_recipe: No recipe yet. Items without a recipe don't use stock.
item.no_ingredients_yet: No ingredients yet. Add them first in
item.no_groups: No modifier groups on this item yet.
item.preview_help: Pick options to see what one sale of this item uses.

modifiers.empty: A modifier group is a question asked when ordering, e.g. Size, Sugar, Ice or Milk. One group can be used on many items.
modifiers.price_delta_help: 0 if it doesn't change the price.
modifiers.confirm_archive_group: Archive group "{name}"? It will be removed from every item.
modifiers.used_on_none: Not used on any item yet
modifiers.items_help: Tick the items that offer this group. Newly ticked items get it last; change the order on the item's page.
modifiers.items_empty: No items yet. Add them on the Menu page first.

effects.title: Ingredient effects: {name}
effects.help: Set how this option changes the recipe. E.g. Oat milk replaces fresh milk; Extra shot adds 18 g of beans.
effects.none: This option doesn't change the recipe.

ingredients.threshold_help: Email when stock falls to this level. 0 = no alert.
ingredients.unit_help: Recipes and stock all use this unit.
ingredients.unit_fixed: The unit can't change after the ingredient is created.
ingredients.purchase_pair: Fill in both the purchase unit name and size, or neither.
ingredients.stock_note: Stock changes through stock-in, waste, stock counts and sales.
ingredients.confirm_archive: Archive ingredient "{name}"? Recipes that use it keep working.
ingredients.empty_help: Ingredients are used in item recipes; each sale lowers stock by the recipe. E.g. Coffee beans (g), Fresh milk (ml), Cup (pcs).

discounts.note: Custom (non-preset) discounts can only be given by an owner or manager at the counter.
discounts.empty_help: Discounts here show up as quick choices at the counter, e.g. Student promo 10% or Rp 5.000 off.

settings.cutoff_help: Orders before this hour count towards the previous day.
settings.tax_on_service: Apply tax to the service charge too
settings.extra_emails_help: Comma separated. The owner always gets them.

problems.category_has_items: The category still has items. Move or archive them first.
problems.option_not_on_item: That option isn't part of this item.
problems.single_select_max_one: A pick-one group allows at most 1.
problems.greater_than_max: The minimum can't exceed the maximum.
problems.fewer_than_defaults: The maximum is below the number of default options.
problems.more_defaults_than_max: More default options than the group's maximum.
problems.replace_same_ingredient_needs_qty: Replacing with the same ingredient needs a new amount.
problems.pin_weak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid repeated digits (1111), runs (1234, 4321) and common patterns (1212).
problems.password_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters.
problems.password_too_long: The password can be at most 128 characters.
problems.password_common: This password is too common. Choose another one.
problems.too_many_groups: One of the items already has 20 groups, the maximum. Remove another group from that item first.

reports.net_note: Net sales = after discounts, before tax and service charge. Voided orders are excluded.
reports.empty: No data for this period yet. Sales from the cashier app show up here.
reports.allocation_note: Order discounts are split across lines by value; the rounding remainder goes to the largest line.
reports.stock_value_note: Stock × current average cost; negative stock counts as zero.

orders.empty: No orders in this period. Orders from the cashier app show up here.

inventory.total_cost_help: What you paid for the whole quantity; the average cost is recalculated.
inventory.count_help: Fill in only what you counted. Empty rows don't change.
inventory.empty_help: Stock is tracked per ingredient. Add ingredients first, then record stock in.

users.email_manager_help: Managers get an email invite to set a password.
users.email_optional: Optional; cashiers and employees sign in with a PIN.
users.pin_help: 4–6 digits. No repeated digits (1111), runs (1234, 4321) or common patterns (1212).

devices.help: Cashier devices paired by an owner or manager.
devices.confirm_revoke: Revoke {name}? Staff on it are signed out immediately.
devices.step_download: Download and install the cashier app on an Android tablet.
devices.step_login: Open the app and sign in with an owner or manager email and password.
devices.step_done: The tablet shows up here. After that, staff just sign in with their PIN.

profile.title: Complete the shop profile
profile.body: Fill in the address and phone (printed on receipts), then check tax, service charge and payment methods.

menu.title: Build the menu
menu.body: Add categories (e.g. Coffee, Non-coffee, Food), then items and prices. Choices like Size or Sugar are set up under Modifiers.

ingredients.title: Add ingredients and recipes
ingredients.body: So stock goes down automatically with every sale. You can skip this and do it later.

staff.title: Add staff
staff.body: Create cashier or employee accounts, each with their own PIN. You can also sell with your own PIN.

device.title: Set up the cashier tablet
device.body: Install the cashier app on an Android tablet, then sign in with the owner email and password to pair it with this shop.

first_order.title: Try one order
first_order.body: Make a test order on the cashier tablet and print the receipt to check prices, tax and the printer. Void it afterwards.

help.cutoff: For shops open past midnight. E.g. with 2, a Saturday 01:30 order counts in Friday's report. Shops that close before midnight can leave it at 0.
help.tax: PB1 (restaurant tax) is usually 10%, depending on your local rules. Tax is added on top of menu prices, because menu prices exclude tax.
help.service: Service charge is an extra percentage on the order, e.g. 5%. Most coffee shops don't use it.
help.tax_on_service: When on, tax is calculated on menu prices plus the service charge. See the example below for the result.
help.base_unit: The unit used to measure the ingredient: grams for coffee and sugar, ml for milk and syrup, pcs for cups and straws. Recipes and stock use this unit, and it can't be changed later.
help.purchase_unit: The unit you buy in, to make stock in faster. E.g. Milk carton = 1000 ml, Cup pack = 50 pcs.
help.avg_cost: Average cost (COGS) per base unit. Calculated automatically from every stock in: the new purchase price is averaged with the stock you already had.
help.recipe: Ingredients used for 1 serving of this item. Every sale lowers stock by the recipe. Items without a recipe can still be sold.
help.item_groups: Modifier groups asked when this item is ordered, e.g. Size or Sugar. Groups are created on the Modifiers page.
help.selection:
Pick one: the customer chooses one option, e.g. Size (Regular or Large).
More than one: e.g. Toppings, the customer may pick several.
help.min_max: Minimum 0 = can be skipped. Minimum 1 = required. Maximum limits how many options can be picked at once.
help.role:
Owner: full access.
Manager: menu, stock, discounts, voids and pairing tablets; signs in to the dashboard with email.
Cashier: takes orders and payments with a PIN.
Employee: sees today's orders and records stock with a PIN.
help.discount_scope:
Whole order: taken off the order total.
Per item: taken off one item, for every serving.
